memo.verdict: Neutral; park, as a watch with two dated triggers and a price; conviction medium at Triaging. Beijer Ref (BEIJ.B-SE) is a cause-for-concern-clearing case in a solid-quality serial acquirer, and at SEK 145.3 it is not yet compelling. The private-equity overhang cleared on 11 June 2026, but the two things the re-rating needs, an organic line back above 3 percent in print and a permanent chief executive, are both still outstanding, so the modal return is about 10 percent a year against the 20 percent bar. The triggers: the Q3 2026 results on 22 October 2026 (group organic growth of 3% or more with North America positive moves the clearing evidence toward B; below 2% or North America still negative moves the return to the uncleared branch) and the chief executive appointment (a credible permanent appointment by mid-2027 is the modal case; no appointment by the full-year 2026 results in early 2027 is the alarm; a caretaker extended beyond mid-2027 is the invalidate level). The price: the case clears the bar below about SEK 128 on the modal path over eighteen months, or below about SEK 141 once both triggers have cleared. The gate line does not fire: management C, business quality C, predictability B, trackability C; the case is parked on price and outstanding evidence, not on the gate. The record does not invalidate the case: "the case is not broken; it is not yet compelling at SEK 145.3."
case: - The thesis: Beijer Ref is a cause-for-concern-clearing case in a solid-quality serial acquirer, not yet compelling at SEK 145.3. The overhang has cleared; the organic line and the chief executive are outstanding; the modal return is about 10% a year against the 20% bar; the bar is met below about SEK 128 on the modal path or below about SEK 141 once both concerns have cleared.

- The change is three identifiable concerns lifting at three speeds. The 24-month-forward multiple fell from a five-year median of 26.94x to 21.05x (2026-09-18), the 11th percentile, because of: (1) the private-equity overhang, cleared 11 June 2026 when Melker Schörling AB took all the A-shares (14.1% of votes) and EQT fell to a 6.4% economic stake; done and partly priced, the shares up 13.6% over six months from about SEK 127 after the Q1 2026 print; (2) the organic engine at 2.6% in 2025, -1.4% Q4 2025, -0.2% Q1 2026, +1% Q2 2026, which management and both covering brokers say re-accelerates from Q3 2026 with about 5% underlying already visible; asserted, not shown, first hard print 22 October 2026; (3) the chief executive's resignation on 23 July 2026, effective 14 August 2026, no successor, no reason beyond "other opportunities"; just opened, no clearing evidence.

- The internal change is a change in who owns and who leads, not yet in what the company does: a new anchor owner, a new chair (Per Bertland, the former chief executive, from 23 April 2026), a lowered leverage ceiling (below 2.5x from below 3x), a cash-flow target; but strategy and five-year targets reaffirmed unchanged, no guidance to raise. The framework's screen wants three strong forces or chief-executive change plus a guidance increase; this case has a departure and no guidance. Internal forces C: chief executive D; other leaders C; strategy change C; guidance raised D; standards improvement B (SEK 100m programme; AutoStore hub with picking speed up four times; SEK 610m working-capital release); perimeter reduction D; new geographies B (Canada, Baltics, New Zealand); new products B (first US CO2 transcritical orders; Fenagy's Billund heat pump; second shifts at SCM Frigo); price rises C (nominal pass-through; gross margin on FactSet's line 9.3% against 9.9%); acquisitions B; balance sheet C; shareholder returns D.
counter_case: - The bull case at full force (Jefferies and DNB Carnegie, July and August 2026): we are being paid to wait. Underlying organic growth is already 5 percent, not 1 percent, on management's decomposition endorsed by both brokers; the green OEM segment grew 25 percent with record backlogs into 2027; the F-gas quota halves on 1 January 2027, fourteen weeks away; the EQT overhang that "historically depressed the valuation" is gone and a capital-disciplined industrial owner is building a stake; the margin held at 12.1 percent through the worst organic quarter; the balance sheet is inside its ceiling; the stock trades at 18x EV/EBIT 2027E against a five-year average of 24x and a 20 to 30 percent discount to the Swedish serial acquirers; targets of SEK 170 to SEK 180 imply about 25 percent upside on top of double-digit EPS growth; the chief executive vacancy is a governance footnote at the end of the EQT era. On that case the eighteen-month return from SEK 145.3 is the cleared branch's about 18 percent a year.

- Conceded: the overhang is gone; the OEM strength is real; the margin resilience is proven; the multiple is at the bottom of its own range; a patient holder from here probably earns the earnings growth plus the yield, about 12 percent a year.
triggers: - Q3 2026 results, 22 October 2026: group organic growth at 3% or more with North America positive moves the organic condition from probable (about 60%) to likely and the clearing evidence toward B; 4%-plus with North America positive moves it to likely; below 2% or North America still negative moves it to possible and the return to the uncleared branch (4.5% a year). Alarm: group organic below 2%; North America negative. Invalidate: group organic below 0% for two consecutive prints; North America negative for two more prints.

- Chief executive appointment: a credible permanent appointment by mid-2027 is the modal case (about 70%); an external appointment from a Swedish compounder or a US distributor would likely re-rate the shares; no appointment by the full-year 2026 results in early 2027 moves it to possible (alarm); a caretaker extended beyond mid-2027 moves it to unlikely (invalidate). If the new chief executive arrives with a new plan and raised ambitions, the sorting moves toward 'Major Corporate Change' and the input-breadth condition re-rates.
- Price: below about SEK 128 on the modal path over eighteen months (SEK 112 over three years) before the first trigger; below about SEK 141 (SEK 141.5) once both triggers have cleared.

- Acquisition cadence: modal about SEK 1.5bn a year of acquired sales; plausible (about 50%) for two quarters, probable thereafter; alarm, no deal announced for two quarters; the leaderless interval is the thing most likely to slow it. Balance-sheet room about one Enertrak-sized deal; alarm above 2.5x net debt to EBITDA on the company's definition.
- Margin: likely (about 75%) to hold at 12 to 13% on the brokers' EBITDA basis; alarm, a quarterly adjusted EBITA margin below the prior year by more than 50 basis points without a named one-off.
- Working capital: modal falling toward 38% of revenue on FactSet's definition; alarm above 44%; obsolescence through the refrigerant transition the skew.
